title: This Bird Stays Through Months of Arctic Darkness. Here's How
subject: rock ptarmigan

scenes.text: Months of darkness. Snow everywhere. And this bird refuses to leave.
The Svalbard rock ptarmigan stays on an Arctic island while the sun stays gone from November to the end of January.
It is the only resident bird there that lives on plants. And in winter, almost nothing grows.
So in autumn it eats and eats, and its body weight can climb by about thirty percent.
Studies found an adult carrying roughly a quarter of its body mass as fat, a living pantry for the dark months.
Then it digs into the snow and waits. The bird that never leaves is simply the one that packed the biggest lunch.

description:
The Svalbard rock ptarmigan stays on its Arctic island through the polar night, when the sun doesn't rise for months.
In autumn its body weight can rise by about 30 percent as it stores fat for the winter.
Would you stay or fly south?
thumbnail_text: THE BIRD THAT STAYS IN THE DARK
first_comment: It survives months of night by eating a huge lunch first: would you rather be a ptarmigan or a migrating tern?
